items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: They used to call it Leon Brumview. ... That's the same blues. ... The way Leon did. ... The Leon used to say, you know. ... It was a Leon.

ctx.x: Aaron Harris killed Buddy Richard, and that's the blues they used to play, poor Buddy Richard. Oh, yeah. Aaron Harris was a bad man in New Orleans. I live across the street from him. Yeah. They used to call it Leon Brumview. Yeah. That's Buddy Richard blues.

The one from Kenwood. Yeah. That's the same blues. You know what they did, they made the Riverside blues. That's the way. Yeah. Now, now, now, see? Little more shirts. Oh, yeah. You can jazz this piece, too. Yeah, they made the Riverside blues. See? They were the, see, they were the, the way Leon did. You can make that bass. That bass. That bass, too. That's just a plain old time way. The kids used to play it when I come up. And then they had this other part, didn't they? Yeah. You know what they said? They…
